decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits close to the firm's core pipeline-fitting business, so it costs little to keep on offer, and after only one year its demand is still uncertain, which makes keeping the option worthwhile.

The ceiling or floor pipe bracket has a page of its own and is a low-cost extension of the firm's existing fabrication, and no evidence yet shows its value will not be realized, so the option should be kept open.

The pipe support bracket is prominently presented, builds on established capabilities at minimal carrying cost, and has had too little time on the market for its uncertainty to resolve, so dropping it now would be premature.
